Each cell is the cheapest valid configuration among the
32 default specs for a 20 MW IT load; the number is its
fuel use in MW. 54 of 63 cells have a valid
configuration; engine + absorption has none in 28 cells.
Simulation: design.search.enumerate_designs, 63 cells, supply 291.15 K, return 301.15 K, relative humidity 0.5, no grid import.
